posts.title: SQL Joins in 60 seconds (sample)
posts.desc:
INNER JOIN: only matching rows.
LEFT JOIN: all left rows + matches (NULL if none).
RIGHT JOIN: mirror of LEFT.
FULL JOIN: everything from both sides.
Tip: always say which column you join on and why.
